GENERAL PROVISIONS

1.001 State policy for courts. The courts shall be open. [1981 s.s. c.3 §1]

1.002 Supreme Court. The Chief Justice is the administrative head. See also 7.095 for related fees. [1959 c.552 §1; 1973 c.484 §1]
